categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tianyishangjia High-tech Materials Corp., Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: rail transit, photovoltaic new energy, automotive, and aerospace. The rail transit segment focuses on powder metallurgy brake pads for high-speed trains and other rail vehicles. The photovoltaic segment produces carbon-carbon composite materials and quartz crucibles for solar applications. The automotive segment develops high-performance carbon-ceramic brake discs for new energy vehicles and commercial vehicles. The aerospace segment manufactures resin-based carbon fiber composites, carbon-based composites, and precision large aerospace structural parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced powder metallurgy technology for manufacturing brake pads, chemical vapor deposition, continuous asphalt impregnation, and carbonization for carbon-carbon composites, and automated production lines for quartz crucibles. It has proprietary technologies in carbon fiber preform production, high-temperature purification, and coating processes for carbon-ceramic brake discs. The aerospace segment employs resin-based composite molding techniques including hot pressing, molding, winding, and RTM, alongside precision CNC machining for metal aerospace components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national railway bureaus and their subsidiaries, CRRC vehicle manufacturers, photovoltaic silicon crystal manufacturers, high-end equipment manufacturers, leading new energy vehicle OEMs, commercial vehicle manufacturers, and aerospace entities such as China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation and China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. The company serves markets in high-speed rail, urban rail transit, photovoltaic solar energy, new energy vehicles, aerospace, and defense sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases and subsidiaries located in Beijing, Tianjin, Chengdu, Mianyang, Jiangyou, Xuzhou, and Changzhou. Its products serve domestic markets extensively, including eastern, central, and western regions of China. There is limited mention of overseas operations, primarily in terms of patent filings and some foreign currency transactions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianyishangjia operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier of high-tech materials and components. It produces critical parts such as brake pads, carbon-carbon composites, quartz crucibles, and aerospace structural components, supplying directly to OEMs and system integrators in rail, automotive, photovoltaic, and aerospace industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in new materials and industrial application platforms, focusing on upgrading equipment towards large-scale, automated, continuous, and intelligent production. R&D priorities include developing next-generation powder metallurgy brake pads for ultra-high-speed trains, carbon-carbon and carbon-ceramic composites for photovoltaic and automotive applications, and advanced resin-based and carbon-based composites for aerospace. It invests heavily in patent development and process optimization to enhance product performance and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of high-tech materials and components to industrial customers. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including participation in tenders, competitive negotiations, and strategic partnerships. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income, but these are ancillary to its core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the rail transit segment, Tianyishangjia is a leading domestic supplier with the largest market share and extensive certification coverage. In photovoltaic materials, it is a top-tier player with advanced production capabilities and a growing market presence. In automotive carbon-ceramic brakes, it is an emerging leader challenging European incumbents like Brembo and SGL Carbon. In aerospace composites and precision manufacturing, it is a recognized supplier with growing influence. The company maintains competitive advantages through technology leadership, scale, and integrated production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 763 million, a 63.85% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to market downturns in photovoltaic and rail sectors. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.495 billion, impacted by asset impairment and inventory write-downs. Despite the downturn, the company increased R&D investment to 14.37% of revenue. Total assets stood at RMB 6.46 billion with net assets of RMB 3.67 billion. The company is undergoing a challenging phase but continues to invest in growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tianyishangjia emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced materials that break foreign monopolies, such as domestically produced powder metallurgy brake pads for high-speed trains. Its products offer superior performance, reliability, and safety under demanding conditions. The company differentiates through integrated R&D, automated and intelligent manufacturing, and comprehensive certification coverage. It provides customized, high-purity, and long-life materials for photovoltaic and aerospace applications, and cutting-edge carbon-ceramic brake solutions for new energy vehicles, positioning itself as a technology-driven, quality-focused leader.
